DESCRIPTION
David Scally of David Ross Estate Agents your local property experts are pleased to present new to the market 143. This wonderful A rated 3 bedroom mid-terrace home was built by Associate Properties in the late 1940`s. The property offers a practical layout and light filled living space and will appeal to a host of purchasers.
No. 143 Brandon Road is ideally located in this mature and settled location. It is conveniently located close to a host of amenities including a selection of primary and secondary schools, shops including the Ashleaf Shopping centre and Crumlin Village and the soon to be new Crumlin Shopping Centre. The transport links are excellent as the property is within easy reach of the City Centre, it is well serviced by a regular bus service and the RED LUAS line is a pleasant 10 minute stroll away. 
Accommodation comprises of entrance hallway, light filled front reception room with feature fireplace, beyond this is a large second reception room again with featured fireplace. Finally to complete the ground floor you will find a galley kitchen. 
To the rear of the property is a large West facing garden with a lawn and surrounded by matures bushes and shrubs.
Upstairs there are 3 generous sized bedrooms 2 large doubles and 1 single. There is also fully tiled family bathroom.
Early viewing of this property is highly recommended as interest will be high.
Viewing by appointment only.

FEATURES.
150mm Exterior insulation
Off Street Parking
Double glazed throughout.
Heat pump
Excellent location
Large rear west facing garden
Re-Plumbed & Re-Wired Circa 2025
